cost.upHint: The cost sheet now gives {amount} more a piece than the cost this line was priced at: price it again from the cost or the list.
cost.downHint: The cost sheet now gives {amount} less a piece than the cost this line was priced at.

edit.action: What happens below the minimum of {subject}

problem.quantity: A minimum is a whole number of pieces, from 2 to 1,000,000.
problem.per: Choose what the minimum counts: per order, per colourway or per line.
problem.action: Choose what happens below the minimum: warn, block or a small-run surcharge.
problem.surchargeFirst: Type the small-run surcharge in its cell (an amount or a %): the minimum then becomes a small-run surcharge.
problem.surchargeNeeded: A small-run surcharge needs its amount or percent: choose warn or block to have none.
problem.surcharge: A surcharge is an amount above 0 (12.50) or a percent above 0 and at most 100 (3%).
problem.note: A note of at most {limit} characters.

held.noManage: Changing minimums needs the right to manage price lists.
held.listArchived: The price list is archived: reactivate it to change its minimums.
held.archived: This minimum is archived: reactivate it to change it.
held.noPrice: The surcharge is a price: your role does not see selling prices.

refused.moved: Someone else changed this minimum: it is read again. Type the change once more.
refused.conflict: Not saved: another active minimum already counts the same way for this subject.
refused.invalid: Not saved: the minimum is not valid as typed.
refused.unavailable: Not saved: the server could not be reached. Try again.

pdf.title: PDF kept for mail
pdf.sub: A copy of this version kept as a PDF: a mail to a customer attaches that same file.
pdf.failed: The kept PDFs couldn't be read
pdf.upToDateHint: Shows this version as it is now.
pdf.outdatedHint: Keep it again before sending: the mail sends a new one by itself.
pdf.none: No PDF kept for this version yet.
pdf.keep: Keep this version as a PDF

sendHeld.subject: A subject of at most 200 characters.
sendHeld.customer: Choose the customer it goes to.

pdf.sendNewest: The newest PDF in {language} goes attached.
pdf.sendKeepsFirst: A new PDF in {language} is kept first, then it goes attached.
pdf.toHint: Empty: the customer's contact (its orders contact first). Or addresses, separated by commas.
pdf.subject: Subject
pdf.subjectHint: Empty: “Price list” with the list's code and name.
pdf.messageHint: Empty: a short message naming the list and its version.
pdf.keptSame: PDF {version} already shows this version: nothing new was kept.

held.noPrice: The PDF holds the prices: your role does not see selling prices.
held.noManage: Keeping and sending a price list needs the right to manage price lists.
held.noVersion: The price list has no version to print yet.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.everyCompany: A list of every company has no company to send from: keep its PDF and send it from a company's mail.
held.noCustomer: No customer has this list yet: give it to a customer first (Customers tab).

problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this with this price list.
problem.conflict: Refused: the company's legal data for the letterhead is not complete, or the list changed meanwhile.
problem.invalid: Refused: something in the request is not valid.
problem.notFound: The price list or its version is gone.
problem.unavailable: The server could not be reached. Try again.

pdf.customerHint: One of the customers that have this list: the mail goes on its conversation, a copy of the kept PDF with it.

design.title: Lines and their cost
design.sub: The cost each line was priced at, and how far it moved since.
